body.name: d_arrow
body.sig: \(d_{\to}:\mathcal K_0(K)\times\mathcal K_0(K)\to[0,\infty]\), where \(\mathcal K_0(K)\) contains all closed subsets of \(K\), including \(\varnothing\)
body.def: \(d_{\to}(A,B)=0\) if \(A=\varnothing\); \(d_{\to}(A,B)=+\infty\) if \(A\neq\varnothing\) and \(B=\varnothing\); and \(d_{\to}(A,B)=\sup_{a\in A}\inf_{b\in B}|a-b|\) otherwise
